finding: The v2 authorization bound the corrected freeze timestamp, but run.py did not require the VCC_PROVENANCE_UTC override to equal that exact value.
The source-build path held a donor lock, but source-evaluate and source-gate did not share an experiment-wide heavy-stage lock.
The superseded v1 provenance hashes were recorded in v2 but were not enforced by the freeze command.

correction.freeze_timestamp: Require VCC_PROVENANCE_UTC and require its UTC-normalized value to equal the authorization's freeze_provenance_utc binding.
correction.heavy_stage_serialization: Acquire one exclusive experiment-wide lock around every CLI source-build, source-evaluate, and source-gate command.
correction.superseded_provenance: Validate the immutable v2 authorization, v1 preoutcome authorization, and v1 K562 reconstruction manifest before publishing the repaired freeze.
